feature_queries.name: base
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.UserID, e.timestamp, EXTRACT('dow' FROM e.timestamp) AS dow FROM eval_table e

feature_queries.name: user_info
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.UserID, e.timestamp, ui.UserAgentID, ui.UserAgentOSID, ui.UserDeviceID, ui.UserAgentFamilyID FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN UserInfo ui USING (UserID)

feature_queries.name: visit_agg
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.UserID,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(v.ViewDate) AS visits_30d,
  COUNT(v.ViewDate) FILTER (WHERE v.ViewDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '4 days') AS visits_4d,
  COUNT(v.ViewDate) FILTER (WHERE v.ViewDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '1 day') AS visits_1d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT v.AdID) AS distinct_ads_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT v.IPID) AS distinct_ip_30d,
  MIN(epoch(e.timestamp - v.ViewDate)/3600.0) AS hours_since_last_visit
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN VisitStream v
  ON v.UserID = e.UserID
 AND v.ViewDate < e.timestamp
 AND v.ViewDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: search_info_agg
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.UserID,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(si.SearchDate) AS searches_30d,
  COUNT(si.SearchDate) FILTER (WHERE si.SearchDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '4 days') AS searches_4d,
  AVG(si.IsUserLoggedOn) AS avg_loggedon_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT si.LocationID) AS distinct_loc_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT si.CategoryID) AS distinct_cat_30d,
  MIN(epoch(e.timestamp - si.SearchDate)/3600.0) AS hours_since_last_search
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN SearchInfo si
  ON si.UserID = e.UserID
 AND si.SearchDate < e.timestamp
 AND si.SearchDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: search_click_agg
feature_queries.sql:
WITH sids AS (
  SELECT e.UserID, e.timestamp, si.SearchID
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN SearchInfo si
    ON si.UserID = e.UserID
   AND si.SearchDate < e.timestamp
   AND si.SearchDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT
  s.UserID,
  s.timestamp,
  COUNT(st.SearchDate) AS impressions_30d,
  SUM(st.IsClick) AS clicks_30d,
  SUM(st.IsClick) FILTER (WHERE st.SearchDate >= s.timestamp - INTERVAL '4 days') AS clicks_4d,
  AVG(st.IsClick) AS ctr_30d,
  AVG(st.Position) AS avg_pos_30d,
  AVG(st.HistCTR) AS avg_histctr_30d,
  MIN(st.Position) FILTER (WHERE st.IsClick = 1) AS best_click_pos_30d
FROM sids s
LEFT JOIN SearchStream st
  ON st.SearchID = s.SearchID
 AND st.SearchDate < s.timestamp
 AND st.SearchDate >= s.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: search_click_flags
feature_queries.sql:
WITH sids AS (
  SELECT e.UserID, e.timestamp, si.SearchID
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN SearchInfo si
    ON si.UserID = e.UserID
   AND si.SearchDate < e.timestamp
   AND si.SearchDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    s.UserID,
    s.timestamp,
    COUNT(st.SearchDate) AS impressions_30d,
    SUM(st.IsClick) AS clicks_30d
  FROM sids s
  LEFT JOIN SearchStream st
    ON st.SearchID = s.SearchID
   AND st.SearchDate < s.timestamp
   AND st.SearchDate >= s.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  UserID,
  timestamp,
  (impressions_30d > 0)::INT AS has_impressions_30d,
  (clicks_30d > 0)::INT AS has_clicks_30d,
  LOG(1 + COALESCE(impressions_30d,0)) AS log_impressions_30d,
  LOG(1 + COALESCE(clicks_30d,0)) AS log_clicks_30d
FROM agg

feature_queries.name: phone_req_agg
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.UserID,
  e.timestamp,
  COUNT(p.PhoneRequestDate) AS phone_reqs_30d,
  COUNT(p.PhoneRequestDate) FILTER (WHERE p.PhoneRequestDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '4 days') AS phone_reqs_4d,
  MIN(epoch(e.timestamp - p.PhoneRequestDate)/3600.0) AS hours_since_last_phone_req
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN PhoneRequestsStream p
  ON p.UserID = e.UserID
 AND p.PhoneRequestDate < e.timestamp
 AND p.PhoneRequestDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: phone_adsinfo_agg
feature_queries.sql:
WITH pr AS (
  SELECT
    e.UserID,
    e.timestamp,
    p.AdID
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN PhoneRequestsStream p
    ON p.UserID = e.UserID
   AND p.PhoneRequestDate < e.timestamp
   AND p.PhoneRequestDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT
  pr.UserID,
  pr.timestamp,
  COUNT(pr.AdID) AS phone_ads_30d,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ai.CategoryID) AS phone_distinct_cat_30d,
  AVG(LOG(1 + ai.Price)) AS phone_avg_logprice_30d,
  MIN(LOG(1 + ai.Price)) AS phone_min_logprice_30d,
  MAX(LOG(1 + ai.Price)) AS phone_max_logprice_30d
FROM pr
LEFT JOIN AdsInfo ai ON ai.AdID = pr.AdID
GROUP BY 1,2

feature_queries.name: ratios_flags_v2
feature_queries.sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT
    e.UserID,
    e.timestamp,
    COUNT(vs.ViewDate) AS visits_30d,
    COUNT(vs.ViewDate) FILTER (WHERE vs.ViewDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '4 days') AS visits_4d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN VisitStream vs
    ON vs.UserID = e.UserID
   AND vs.ViewDate < e.timestamp
   AND vs.ViewDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), s AS (
  SELECT
    e.UserID,
    e.timestamp,
    COUNT(si.SearchDate) AS searches_30d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN SearchInfo si
    ON si.UserID = e.UserID
   AND si.SearchDate < e.timestamp
   AND si.SearchDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), c AS (
  WITH sids AS (
    SELECT e.UserID, e.timestamp, si.SearchID
    FROM eval_table e
    LEFT JOIN SearchInfo si
      ON si.UserID = e.UserID
     AND si.SearchDate < e.timestamp
     AND si.SearchDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
  )
  SELECT
    sids.UserID,
    sids.timestamp,
    COUNT(st.SearchDate) AS impressions_30d,
    SUM(st.IsClick) AS clicks_30d
  FROM sids
  LEFT JOIN SearchStream st
    ON st.SearchID = sids.SearchID
   AND st.SearchDate < sids.timestamp
   AND st.SearchDate >= sids.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), p AS (
  SELECT
    e.UserID,
    e.timestamp,
    COUNT(pr.PhoneRequestDate) AS phone_30d
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN PhoneRequestsStream pr
    ON pr.UserID = e.UserID
   AND pr.PhoneRequestDate < e.timestamp
   AND pr.PhoneRequestDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  e.UserID,
  e.timestamp,
  (COALESCE(v.visits_30d,0) > 0)::INT AS has_visits_30d,
  (COALESCE(s.searches_30d,0) > 0)::INT AS has_searches_30d,
  (COALESCE(c.clicks_30d,0) > 0)::INT AS has_clicks_30d,
  (COALESCE(p.phone_30d,0) > 0)::INT AS has_phone_30d,
  v.visits_4d * 1.0 / NULLIF(v.visits_30d, 0) AS frac_visits_4d_of_30d,
  c.clicks_30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(c.impressions_30d, 0) AS ctr_from_counts_30d,
  p.phone_30d * 1.0 / NULLIF(v.visits_30d, 0) AS phone_per_visit_30d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN v USING (UserID, timestamp)
LEFT JOIN s USING (UserID, timestamp)
LEFT JOIN c USING (UserID, timestamp)
LEFT JOIN p USING (UserID, timestamp)
